mistake_reason: Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): The Assistant incorrectly treated WikiBlame and Find addition/removal outputs as definitive evidence of the first-ever image addition. Both tools explicitly stated that their results were limited to the selected scan window and warned that earlier occurrences might exist. The Assistant ignored these warnings, misconstrued the earliest-in-window result (2011-06-15) as the absolute first addition, and further interpreted Wayback snapshots with missing resources (clear warnings about incomplete loading) as proof of absence. This misreading of tool outputs led to the wrong conclusion and date selection.
